description: A Java JUnit test class for integration testing Office-related API endpoints in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup methods for REST-assured configurations and multiple test cases for creating, updating, and retrieving Office entities using different identifiers.

classes.name: OfficeIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class containing setup and multiple test methods for Office API integration testing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured configuration before each test, setting content type and authorization headers.

methods.name: testOfficeModification
methods.description: Tests updating an office and verifies the name and opening date.

methods.name: testOfficeModificationWithExternalId
methods.description: Tests updating an office using external ID and verifies the updated details.

methods.name: testOfficeModificationAndFetchWithExternalId
methods.description: Tests updating office details via external ID and retrieves it to verify updates.
